content:
If you have closed that Gmail account, and it's still set up in Thunderbird, you should copy all messages that you want to keep to Local Folders, then delete the account from Thunderbird. When you're asked to delete all data, including stored passwords, you can say 'yes' because you've already backed it up.

Also, remove any Gmail remote Calendars and Address Books you may be subscribed to that are associated with that account.

content:
Normally, if you transfer a profile, all contents in the profile transfer, so it's possible your transfer was not for the full profile.. If you have access to the old PC, the files you want are these two:: abook.sqlite and history.sqlite. If you're comfortable with windows file explorer you can simply copy from the old computler and paste into the new computer. Here are steps:

  1. click help>troubleshootinginformation on old PC
  2. scroll to 'profile folder' and click 'open folder
  3. exit thunderbird, you are now in profile
  4. copy abook.sqlite and history.sqlite to external media
  5. on new pc, repeat the first three steps above
  6. now, you are in profile of new PC, paste the two copied files here
  7. restart thunderbird
